description: Integrate Strategic Insights into Your Power BI Dashboards with PowerKPIs Use PowerKPIs as the new central entry point for your analysis in Power BI. It provides a powerful platform for illustrating the connections between different KPIs in an engaging value driver tree format, adding valuable context to data-driven decisions. From top-level summaries to detailed examinations of specific operational drivers, PowerKPIs enhances your ability to tell a compelling story of business performance through a single, intuitive interface. Key Features at a Glance Custom Views: Customizable KPI views provide precise control for business units to dissect and strategize based on their unique needs. Formatting: Change the layout view and chart type on the KPI card, customize border and text colors, set a custom hierarchy, and format your card as a number, currency, or percentage. Align PowerKPIs with your brand with ease. Metric Settings: PowerKPIs offers an array of metric-specific settings. Choose the relationship between KPI cards based on mathematical calculations or softer influences. Define the steer type to indicate whether a higher or lower figure is better, and discover many more configuration options. Why PowerKPIs?
